log.answer:
Filter for region=='West': scanning all 20 rows yields exactly 4 West rows: ORD-1195(shipped,69.62), ORD-1666(pending,25.81), ORD-1209(shipped,97.13), ORD-1728(shipped,17.18). No other West rows exist in the data.

Shipped-only West rows: ORD-1195(69.62), ORD-1209(97.13), ORD-1728(17.18).

Sum = 69.62+97.13+17.18 = 183.93
Count = 3
Average = 183.93/3 = 61.31

```python
rows = [(69.62,'shipped'),(25.81,'pending'),(97.13,'shipped'),(17.18,'shipped')]
prices = [p for p,s in rows if s=='shipped']
assert len(prices)==3
assert round(sum(prices)/len(prices),2)==61.31
```

The question explicitly asks for the average of unit_price (not a units-weighted/revenue-based average), so the simple mean of the three shipped unit_price values is the correct interpretation.

FINAL: 61.31
